source_layouts._forward_layout_comment: LOCKED 29 Jul 2026 to 'TMP Batch Ninja Depok (Order) 28-07-26.xlsx'; re-applied here 18 Aug 2026 after the repo reorg dropped the earlier fix. SwipeRx removed the leading index column and the per-PO Weight/Volume columns, shifting every field left: ONE header row (data starts row 2), nothing past col M. Both forward services share this layout. Continuation PO rows carry only E..M (A/B/C blank). Older batches (4 header rows, koli in N or W) will NOT parse against this.
source_layouts._header_checks_comment: header_checks: cells the uploaded file's header row must match (case-insensitive, trimmed) before parsing starts. Catches a non-TMP file — or a layout drift — with a clear 422 instead of committing garbage (OC_AWB_PARENT_CHECK.md 7b). The `return` layout has none defined; S3 is disabled.

_origins_comment: The two SwipeRx warehouses a delivery can ship out of. The origin is chosen at Order creation and STORED on every AWB in the batch, so a return can be addressed back to where it actually came from instead of being looked up by hand. On a return OC row this block fills the `to.*` columns (J-Q) — get it wrong and the parcel goes to the wrong city. `warehouse` above is the legacy single-origin block and still drives forward rows; it is identical to TMP_DEPOK.

_return_oc_comment: Constants for the POD-Return OC row, read off the real '[Template DE POD Return] Swipe RX R01.xlsx'. Structure is OPTION 1 (single TRID): one row per reject, AB=1, one child. Direction is reversed — `from` is the pharmacy, `to` is the origin warehouse above. Col R is the bare word 'Retur' (no link, no RDO wording) and col AA is EMPTY, unlike a forward row.
